name: MetalTyrannomon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] You may reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 level 6 card with the [Machine] trait among them to your hand. Trash the remaining cards.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has the [Machine] trait, it gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.).
